title: Yona of the Dawn
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Princess Yona's sheltered life ends when her childhood friend Su-won murders her father, the pacifist king, and seizes the throne. Fleeing with her bodyguard Hak, she seeks the four legendary dragon warriors and learns to fight, negotiate and help her declining kingdom.
life_message: A good life means growing from privilege into courage and service to the people.

content.note: Coup, a king's murder, wars and sword fights (Wikipedia; AniList War 76%).
